units.function: Stores an accepted async company-import job handle in browser sessionStorage, recovers one job by company prefix after reload and throttles status polling while a tab is hidden.
units.dependencyDirection: Browser-only bookkeeping has no domain dependency and relies directly on sessionStorage/document/timers. It assumes server semantics such as one live job per user and in-memory job expiry.
units.keyDataModels: StoredImportJob with jobId and pauseAutomations; composite storage key from company ID and package name.
units.lifecycle: Persist job handle; scan and repair malformed session entries; resume first matching job after reload; clear terminal/unknown jobs externally; wait three seconds repeatedly while hidden.
units.testAssessment: No direct focused unit tests were found. CompanyImport page tests mock waitForNextImportJobPoll, so malformed storage, key collisions, multiple entries, hidden-tab waits, cancellation and cross-user/session cases are not owned here.
units.designRationale: Let browser polling survive transient connection loss or page reload without making the import operation itself depend on the tab.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs durable, resumable high-risk operations with stable job/event APIs across managed-cloud and self-hosted deployments, while the Web stores only a non-authoritative cursor.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the tiny reload-resume UX pattern, but use opaque server-issued operation handles scoped to deployment/tenant/user, durable server persistence, expiry/version fields, AbortSignal-aware waiting and realtime-with-poll fallback. Never trust pause or authority state from sessionStorage.
units.responsibilityConflict: The stored handle contains no initiating human, reviewed plan/package digest, target company revision, approval identity or result evidence; pauseAutomations can be client-tampered and must not become authority input.
evidence: 276ae3a75d1661b360f1ff30506942a6d0d0647c Harden company import: durable UI, async jobs, integrity guard, batched inserts (#10523)
symbol search: CompanyImport tests mock the polling wait; no direct focused test owner
securityFindings: sessionStorage is user-controlled; jobId and pauseAutomations are only shape-checked and cannot be authoritative.
Keys concatenate companyId/packageName with colons without encoding, permitting ambiguous collisions if package names contain delimiters.
Recovery returns the first matching entry and assumes one live job per user; stale/multiple jobs have no deterministic newest/version/expiry selection.
Handles are not scoped to deployment origin, authenticated user or job digest in their stored shape.
Polling wait has no AbortSignal and hidden tabs can remain in an unbounded loop until visible.
